purpose: Actual cut, ownership and mass/loading baseline before physics changes. Flyer regressions are not SOL acceptance.

tree.scope: Unchanged source RedBrick tree-shaped structure; actual native eight-cell support cut, one body/six exact proxies; hole and concavity preserved.

building.scope: Separately authored inert RedBrick single-pier building frame, actual native cut/discovery/commit; not original520 geometry.

mass_contract: Retain source unit mass per member. Independently sum M,cell-centre COM and unit-square I; compare source receipt, proxy areas and actual server values within four float32 ULPs. Descriptor density ranks are not calibrated physical mass. No guessed Sand mass.
measurements: Every actual Rapier step before/after pose,v,omega,M,I,COM,total gravity/damping, hard contacts/impulses, maximum proxy-vertex speed, existing capped native wrench/correction and sample/publication ages. Native pre-cut/prepared/commit/final full tuples/census/ownership and actual single RID. Per-step hard geometry uses unchanged inert terrain; Sand observations retain asynchronous field age and cannot claim synchronized clearance. Include all observer/refused work and costs.

gates.ownership: Native owns all source tuples before commit, aggregate owns them after commit; no duplicate native source, exact rectangle union, one actual body, no physics step inside handoff. No pose writes after initial placement.
gates.motion: Dry gravity produces downward motion and actual hard contact. NEW diagnostic rest screen last120 of720: peakCOMspeed<=0.5cell/s,peakabsomega<=0.02rad/s,spanx/y<=0.5cell,angle span<=0.05rad. Report maximum vertex speed separately. Not the original120+60 SOL364 clock.
gates.geometry: Independently report area/depth and original per-cell/proxy1e-9 hard witnesses. Original area1e-6/depth2e-5 remain separate strict references. Quiet interpenetration is not physical clearance.
gates.weight: Record m*g/60 against ordinary aggregate cap3 and separate historical Sand-response wrench. Source cell counts and density ranks do not prove relative physical weight. No force or mass retuning in this baseline. A fix requires a new source-bound registration after a specific defect is identified.

limits: HomogeneousWall/RedBrick only; Wood/reactive/mixed cohesion remains refused. No generalized fracture, multiple aggregates, restoration365 or cross-source World/MAT composition. Keep all PRs Draft, original SOL failures and frozen guards unchanged.
